name: The Scrapfield
description: A vast junkyard of pre-war vehicles, collapsed warehouses, and tangled wire. The Iron Covenant uses it as a dumping ground for defeated rivals. Good salvage if you're fast — or deadly if you're not.

interactables.label: Crashed Delivery Truck
interactables.text: The cab is crushed flat. The trailer has rusted open — someone already cleaned it out long ago. A faded company logo: HARTWELL LOGISTICS. Underneath: 'Delivering Tomorrow, Today.' Tomorrow never came.

interactables.label: Promising Scrap Pile
interactables.text: Bent rebar, broken tiles, wire coils. Nothing immediately useful, but a scrapper from Haven Ridge could probably find something here.

ambient_description: Wind through twisted metal. Something shifts in the shadows behind a collapsed wall. The crunch of broken glass underfoot.
